 Agreed Compliance Measures
 Conflict of interest screens are preventive compliance measures, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Conflict of Interest Act (Act) by public office holders and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist them in avoiding conflicts of interest. Screens also seek to minimize the possibility of conflicts arising between the public duties of the public office holders and their private interests or those of their relatives and friends.
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that a conflict of interest screen is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity to further the private interests of my brother, Mr. Graham Fox, Head of Government and Public Affairs with Dominion Dynamics or to give preferential treatment to Dominion Dynamics or its subsidiaries, affiliates and associates, while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a public office holder.
Accordingly, I have agreed to recuse myself from any discussion or decision in relation to my brother and his employer. I understand that recusal means I must remove myself from the room, physically or virtually as the case may be. I also agree not to have any communication with government officials in relation to any matter or decision-making processes which I or the screen administrator knows or reasonably should know to affect my brother’s private interests or those of Dominion Dynamics or its subsidiaries, affiliates and associates. 
This screen is administered by my Chief of Staff to ensure that I am neither made aware of nor participate in any official matters or decision-making processes involving my brother or his employer Dominion Dynamics’ private interests. I will participate in decisions or matters of general application and those that may affect my brother or his employer’s private interests as a member of a broad class of persons unless those interests are disproportionate to the other members of the class.
Moreover, all powers, duties and functions on matters that form part of this screen will be exercised by the Senior Associate Deputy Minister.
My minister, colleagues and necessary public servants have been informed in writing about this conflict of interest screen. 
I have undertaken to inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner at the earliest opportunity of all changes of which I become aware that relate to or should form part of the above list of matters caught by this screen. 
In the event that I am made aware of a matter forming part of this screen or any such matter comes before me, I am required under section 21 of the Act to recuse myself from that matter, by leaving the room or the virtual meeting where the discussion and decision making is taking place. I must so inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics
 Conflict of interest screens are preventive compliance measures, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Conflict of Interest Act (Act) by a public office holder and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist public office holders in avoiding conflicts of interest. Screens also seek to minimize the possibility of conflicts arising between the public duties of the public office holder and their private interests or those of their relatives and friends.
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that a conflict of interest screen is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity to further the private interests of my relative, Mr. Graham Fox, Vice President, Public Affairs, External Relations and Communications for Hydro Québec or to give preferential treatment to Hydro Québec or its subsidiaries, affiliates and associates, while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a reporting public office holder.

— Page 2 —
Accordingly, I have agreed to abstain from any discussion or decision in relation to Mr. Fox, Hydro Québec or its subsidiaries, affiliates and associates. I also agree not to have any communication with government officials in relation to any matter or decision-making processes affecting my relative's interests. 
This screen is administered by my Chief of Staff and the Chief of Staff to the Clerk of the Privy Council Office to ensure that I am neither made aware of nor participate in any official matters or decision-making processes involving my relative's private interests, unless the interest relates to a decision or matter that is of general application.
Moreover, all powers, duties and functions on matters that form part of this screen will be exercised by the Clerk of the Privy Council Office. 
The Clerk of the Privy Council Office’s staff, my staff (direct reports) and colleagues have been informed in writing about this conflict of interest screen. 
I have undertaken to inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner at the earliest opportunity of all changes of which I become aware that relate to or should form part of the above list of matters caught by this screen. In the event that I am made aware of a matter forming part of this screen or any such matter comes before me, I am required under section 21 of the Act to recuse myself from that matter. 
I must so inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and, where appropriate, make a public declaration of recusal pursuant to subsection 25(1) of the Act.
